onboarding.step1.title: Find a train
onboarding.step1.body: Choose a departure station, a destination and a travel date.
onboarding.step2.title: Check your trip
onboarding.step2.body: Review times and transfers, and see where the information comes from: demo data, a published timetable, or a cache.
onboarding.step3.title: Tickets
onboarding.step3.body: Buying tickets in this app is not available yet. When an authorized purchase path exists, it will be clearly marked here. Keep a valid ticket ready for inspection.
onboarding.step4.title: Map and language
onboarding.step4.body: Find stations on the map and switch between Bulgarian and English in Settings.
